issues.description: The template repository defines the fixed-point size (FIX_LEN) differently in the test headers and the example program: tests/src/math_fix.h sets FIX_LEN to 4 (32-bit) while the example program uses FIX_LEN = 8 (64-bit) in math_fix.c / math_fix.h. This produces different typedefs for fix_t across the tests and the example program, causing mismatched integer widths/ABI expectations and likely compilation or runtime/linking confusion when students build and run the provided targets.
issues.suggestedFix: Make FIX_LEN consistent across the repository. Prefer aligning tests with the example program by changing tests/src/math_fix.h to define FIX_LEN as 8 (or conversely change example_program to 4) so that the typedef of fix_t is identical for tests and the example program. Ensure both math_fix.h and math_fix.c (and any test headers) use the same FIX_LEN value.
